title: Group of Five Young Children in Backyard Garden, 1936 B&W Vintage Photo
back_text_transcription:
Back Row Unknown,

1936

Front Row:

Shirley Russell - Howard Libby and
Beverly Russell
description: A charming group portrait from 1936 showing five young children gathered outdoors in front of a wooden picket fence and a blossoming garden bush. In the front row, three seated children are identified: Shirley Russell wearing a puffed-sleeve dress with a hair bow, Howard Libby in work overalls with a bright smile, and toddler Beverly Russell holding a baby doll beside a miniature wooden high chair and doll crib. Two older girls stand behind them. The print features a decorative Art Deco geometric border typical of 1930s domestic photo finishing.
